target_customer: Developers and engineering teams building internal tools
problem: Low code builders limit developers while writing internal tools from scratch is slow.
business_model: Developer tooling with starter kit, VS Code extension and hosted deployment, pricing not found

founders.name: Rohan Mayya
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built apps and tools that reached 1M sign-ups.

founders.name: Saifur Rahman
founders.background_notes: Worked on domain registration systems per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: An AI code generating extension plus deploy platform is standard engineering with hard LLM reliability problems in early 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Internal tool generation was copyable by Retool and other funded vendors; no data or network effects.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Retool and others added AI features; later search results show many AI internal tool entrants by 2026, but these sources are undated for 2024.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence was found; the landing page asks for early access, suggesting the product had not opened broadly.

branding.domain_note: Uses toolify.sh; the toolify.ai domain belongs to an unrelated AI directory.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found and the name collides with the larger toolify.ai AI directory in search results.

outcome_analysis: Toolify was a two person team in Bengaluru building dev first internal tooling. YC marks it inactive and a founder moved on to a games company, but no shutdown notice or cause is public, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty. The website still shows an early access page.
notes: CB Insights lists a convertible note under former name Creo with no amount or date, so no round could be recorded. No competitor sources dated near the Winter 2024 batch were found, so the list is empty. Several search hits referred to unrelated companies named Toolify.
